program_name: Samsung Care: 12-month built-in limited warranty for Galaxy phones (U.S.)
coverage_summary: Samsung Galaxy phones bought new in the U.S., including Galaxy Z Fold and Flip, for faults in the first 12 months
watch_phrases: Samsung Care is the 12-month built-in limited warranty
coverage: Defects in material and workmanship under normal use and service, for 12 months from delivery to the original purchaser or from the device's first set-up and activation, whichever comes first
remedy: Repair or replacement by Samsung through its authorized walk-in, mobile or mail-in service
mandatory_conditions: The phone was bought new in the United States (the warranty doesn't cover products bought for use outside the U.S.)
The claim is made within 12 months of delivery or first set-up and activation, whichever came first
Service is through one of Samsung's authorized walk-in, mobile (We Come to You) or mail-in options; see samsung.com/service or call 1-800-SAMSUNG
Bring the sales receipt or other proof of purchase showing the original purchase date, the seller's name and address, and the phone's serial number
exclusions_and_caveats: Not covered: defects or damage caused by accident, misuse, abnormal use or conditions, neglect, or unusual physical, electrical or electromechanical stress
Not covered: damage from liquid, moisture, sand, dust or dirt beyond the product's specifications
Not covered: scratches, dents and cosmetic damage, or damage from pressing the touch screen with excessive force
The battery is covered only if its capacity falls below 80% of rated capacity or it leaks
Used phones resold by a dealer or retailer are not covered, except Samsung-certified pre-owned or renewed devices
If Samsung decides the fault isn't covered, you pay for parts, shipping and labor; back up the phone first, as its contents may be erased
Full terms are in Samsung's Standard Limited Warranty for mobile devices (linked below); some carriers and retailers add their own warranty or protection plans
claim_action: Book warranty service before {deadline}: walk in to a Samsung authorized service center, use We Come to You, or start a mail-in repair at samsung.com/service (or call 1-800-SAMSUNG). Back up the phone first and bring the receipt showing the purchase date, the seller and the serial number.
visible_damage_note: Visible physical damage was recorded in the evidence photo. Samsung's warranty does not cover accidental, liquid or cosmetic damage, or damage from pressing the screen with excessive force.
